name: sitrep
description: Under each long reply, a box built from the reply's own lines (haiku only picks line numbers): status, outcome, what you have to do, collapsible sections, and questions you answer from the keyboard (fills the prompt, never sends). Older boxes fold to one line.

language.title: Label language
language.description: Language of sitrep's own labels (status, rows, pane). Reply text always stays in the conversation's language.
